issue: `--extend=N` does not deliver N passes. Both extend steps set `maxIterations` to (iterations already run + N) and reset `status` to initialized, then the classifier resumes the same run, so the next stop decision still sees the old converged state: the review step emits the warning "This run stops on convergence, so it may re-stop on all_dimensions_clean right away. issue: The doc says a depth band gets only its budgetSplit share of --max-iterations. The reducer adds a carry: `allotted = cap * shares[band] + carry`, and at the end of each band `carry = bandOpen ? 0 : Math.max(0, allotted - spent[band])`, so a later band receives the whole unspent share of an earlier band that holds no open node. Band depth2/depth3 can therefore be allotted far more than 0.35/0.15 of max-iterations (up to the whole cap when the earlier bands drained). The same roll-down is described correctly for the research reducer in deep-research/references/state/state-format.md:85, so the two docs disagree.

fix.old: Each depth band gets only its `budgetSplit` share of `--max-iterations` (0.5, 0.35 and 0.15)
fix.new: Each depth band starts from its `budgetSplit` share of `--max-iterations` (0.5, 0.35 and 0.15) plus any share an earlier band left unspent once that band holds no open node
